description: Ready-to-paste contact form code for one form, with its access key, hidden _lang field, botcheck honeypot, and the Turnstile widget if the form has it enabled. html = plain <form> POST; react = component with fetch and inline status; next = the same component marked "use client" for the Next.js App Router.

form_id.description: Form id from list_forms or create_form.

lang.description: Visitor language for labels and Formgong messages (en, uk, pl, tr, de, es, fr, pt, ar, he, hi, ja). Defaults to the form language.

name: get_form_snippet
title: Get form code
